company_name.rule: Preserve official KY/F/foreign-company suffixes. Report/filename names never overwrite official names. Multiple official current values => conflict retained.

filename.numeric_rule: Four ASCII digits nonzero-leading are stock candidates, not proof; long digit strings are date candidates, not proof.
filename.broker_partial: Registered short aliases may match inside filename text; prefer longest alias, Latin token boundary, company-name masking; ambiguity retained.

rules: Use repaired text plus original layout, never cleaned text alone.
Missing period is a title feature, not a sufficient or necessary condition.
Retain relevant small-print rating/price/date/EPS/units; exclude only irrelevant footer/disclaimer content from summary.
Repair within same column/block only; keep numeric signs, decimals, percentages, units and raw provenance.
One sentence/field per record; maintain raw-to-clean links and repair logs.

crosscheck.stock: Exact four-digit local code equality across filename/local/Yahoo/Bloomberg. Market TW/TWO verified separately.
crosscheck.etf: Full local code equality including suffix; never compare only first four digits.

summary.header: 官方證券名稱(已驗證Yahoo代碼)-首頁主標題
summary.missing: Explicit not-disclosed; never invent a fourth claim or diluted EPS.
summary.numeric_origin: Latest adjusted close is an external calculation input; all report narrative facts must be grounded in page 1.

upside.price_source: VDF adjusted price, latest available valid close with as_of; no volume forward fill.
upside.historical_mode: For report-date/backtest metrics use price known as of report date, separate from requested current upside.
upside.target_adjustment: Only apply explicit verified per-share split/conversion factor. Do not blindly multiply the target by a dividend-adjusted AdjClose/Close ratio.

financial.capture: All regions and tables on all identified annual-financial pages, including headers, units, footnotes, formulas and totals.
financial.history_priority: Official historical actuals win only for semantically identical cells; retain report value/delta/revision dates. Estimates remain broker estimates.
financial.anchor: At least one comparable non-ambiguous actual may establish an alignment anchor; not whole-table approval.
checks: Profit / revenue = margin with correct profit definition
YoY with matching period and scope
Diluted EPS numerator / weighted diluted shares, not ending shares
Annual-vs-quarter sums only additive flow metrics, never EPS/ratios/balance-sheet stocks
financial.coverage: Expected pages/tables/rows/cells vs extracted; no file => NOT_RUN. Zero/null/dash distinct.
financial.revision: Current restated history for latest view; point-in-time as_of gate for historical backtests.
